fix: 'tepals' must map to tepal (PO_0009033), not petal; perianths of Allium are tepals, not petals. Also 'almost white' should carry an approximately qualifier on the from_value.
reason: The flora says tepals are almost white to pink; the colour continuum white→pink is right but the bearer is tepal.
Leaf blade green.
2 or 3 lateral (secondary) veins on each side of the leaf blade; count and position slot right.
'whitish' read as approximately white for anthers.

fix: 'X terminates with N umbels' counts umbels per stem (the whole is the stem), not per inflorescence; the inflorescence container is wrong when the counted unit is itself the inflorescence.
reason: 1-6 umbels end the central stem; an umbel counted within an inflorescence (PO_0009049) is a different and incorrect statement.
Herbs 8-30 cm tall: whole plant height.

fix: A bare dimension after 'Stems ... sometimes decumbent' is stem length, not height; height should only come from 'tall' or a whole-plant measure.
reason: Stems 3–15(–25) dm, which can be decumbent, so the measure is length; conversion to cm and the extreme 250 are right.
Cymes 2-10-flowered: 2-10 flowers per inflorescence.
Stamens 100–150.
Fertile bracts 'non carénées' = not keeled; negated keel-shaped on bract is right.
Petiole not winged.
Leaflets glabrous above; adaxial-surface substitution is consistent with the place pattern.
Male florets 5-lobed: 5 corolla lobes (the corolla is the tubular-campanulate part described).

target: auriculate (PATO_0001981) of the acroscopic pinna base
fix: A hyphenated 'shape-auriculate' compound describes an auricle of that shape (deltoid auricle), not a range from one shape to another; do not read it as a continuum. The bearer is also the acroscopic base of the pinna, not the whole pinna.
reason: The flora says the acroscopic pinna bases bear a deltoid auricle; the pinna does not vary from deltoid to auriculate.

fix: 'cottony wool' / 'woolly' should map to lanate (or cottony FLOPO_0980342), not the generic pubescent hair.
reason: Stem densely covered with snow-white cottony wool = lanate; bearer stem is right (branches also).
9-13 secondary veins on each side of the midvein, landmark midvein.

fix: 'glaucous' is a waxy surface bloom (PATO_0104277), not an approximate green; never map it to a colour value.
reason: Rhizome glaucous, waxy: a bloom, which the next word 'waxy' confirms.

fix: In 'A-B or C-D', each hyphenated pair must be read, and the 'or' alternative kept; only the second alternative was annotated, and 'orbicular-cuneate' was dropped.
reason: Leaves are orbicular-cuneate OR broadly elliptic-oblong; the annotation gives only broadly elliptic→oblong and so leaves out the other alternative.

target: calyx tube (FLOPO_0986011), compared with calyx lobe (FLOPO_0986005)
fix: In 'Calyx ..., tube longer than lobes' the tube and lobes are parts of the qualified whole (calyx): bearer calyx tube, target calyx lobe. Bare 'lobes' must not go to leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517).
reason: It is the calyx tube that is longer than the calyx lobes, not the calyx than leaf lobes.
Leaf blade adaxially with appressed trichomes.
Valves strongly reticulate-veined: reticulate pattern on the valve; the 'strongly' degree is lost but harmless.
Bract shorter than culm; culm mapped to stem.
Many-flowered inflorescence: flowers present (many) in the inflorescence.
Plant hoary with appressed hairs = canescent.

fix: 'Flowers thickly textured' in orchids refers to the substance of sepals and petals (thick, fleshy perianth), not to the thickness of the whole flower.
reason: The thickness is of the floral segments, as the next words (sepals and petals ...) indicate.
'no scent' follows the flower/umbel description; odour absent for the flowers.

fix: 'Fleurs centrales ..., env. N par capitule' counts the central (disc) florets per capitulum; the position slot (central) and the whole (capitulum) are needed, and 'env.' should give an approximately qualifier.
reason: Only the central hermaphrodite florets number about 32; total flowers per head is more (marginal florets also exist).

fix: 'Culms below spike ...' needs the place slot (the culm part just below the spike); also glabrous is pilosity, not texture: split into smooth/scabrous (texture) and glabrous (pilosity).
reason: The flora restricts the statement to the culm below the spike and mixes two quality types under 'texture'.
Petiole ± unwinged: approximately not winged.
Leaf blades obscurely serrate-dentate: margin serrated; 'obscurely' degree lost but acceptable.
